## prompt-full-protocol

*Generated by Process A from the master prompt in
[`../prompts/prompt-protocol.md`](../prompts/prompt-protocol.md), adapting
`inputs/auto-bill-02/sub-prompts/prompt-6-full-bill.md` to the Physical AI
oncology trial protocol. Runs in stage `trial-protocol/full-protocol/`.*

Use `trial-protocol/draft-protocol/` and its bracketed **[DRAFTING
INSTRUCTIONS]** to generate the **full** Phase 1 protocol LaTeX and the
corresponding zip into `trial-protocol/full-protocol/`. Execute every bracketed
instruction: render each Stage 1 Mermaid figure as a gray-scale / blue-accent
TikZ `mermaidfig`, set each ASCII figure in its centered white-background
monospace frame, fill every full-width table with its quantitative data carried
from the author sources, and write each NIH section in full so the protocol
stands on its own and reads as if a senior clinical-regulatory author wrote it.
Do not lose any specificity from the draft while making it readable. Utilize the
DOI `10.5281/zenodo.xxxxxxxx`
([https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.xxxxxxxx](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.xxxxxxxx))
and version v4.0.0.

**Figure fidelity (verify twice, Rule for Stage 3).** Each TikZ figure must (a)
have no text-box and arrow overlaps, (b) give every curved/routed arrow the
correct specified looseness (use consistent `to[out=,in=]` / multi-segment
`-- ++(dx,dy)` routing so bends are deliberate, not accidental), and (c) keep
proper spacing between boxes. Each LaTeX figure must carry the **same complexity
and completeness** as its Mermaid source - no simplification. Optimize column
widths for aesthetics based on the draft's measure and the amount of text per
column, so tables match the exact body width with no large interword gaps.

**Content (carry and complete from the draft).** Combined IND/IDE Phase 1 /
early-feasibility design; daraxonrasib 3+3 dose escalation and the perioperative
pause-and-restart advisory; the eight-arm robotic Whipple intervention and its
USL readiness thresholds; the full AE / SAE / Physical AI AE and unanticipated-
problem reporting machinery; the statistical plan (hypotheses, sample size,
analysis populations, interim/stopping logic); the three counterfactual
PFS/OS scenarios; the eight Physical AI concerns and mitigations; the governance
and oversight structure; and the back matter with ORCID and DOI. Cite each main
document with a brief description; use author works only where directly relevant.

**Media and files (Rules 3, 6, 7, 8).** No PNG or JPG; tables, ASCII, and TikZ
`mermaidfig` only; white background throughout. One commit each for `main.tex`,
`protostyle.sty`, `references.bib`, and `README.md`; one commit per
`sections/*.tex`. File `prompt-full-protocol.md` (this prompt verbatim under a
`## prompt-full-protocol` heading) and `output-full-protocol.md`. Push every
commit in real time (10+ commits). The second-to-last commit fixes all errors
across all files. The last commit writes the directory README (DOI badges,
repository structure, colored Mermaid, figure and table inventory split by
medium) and `full-protocol-LaTeX.zip`. Do not overwrite or change anything in
`trial-protocol/draft-protocol/`.

**Formatting.** Avoid large empty white spaces; even interword spacing; no text
running off the right margin; avoid lines with a single or two words; avoid a
single line stranded on the next page; correct "SS" into "§"; single hyphens
only; senior-author `\clearpage`, `\vspace`, and `\hspace` page balancing. Do
not stall, ask questions, or go into plan mode. The LaTeX must compile in
Overleaf with pdfLaTeX.
